profile.headline: Software Engineer at First Republic Bank
profile.summary: Jesse is a skilled backend software engineer with two years of experience in building and optimizing large-scale applications. His work has focused on creating reliable and secure microservices, improving system performance, and implementing CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless deployments. Jesse thrives in collaborative, cross-functional environments and is driven by data insights to enhance user experience and engagement. With a proven track record in delivering impactful solutions, he is excited about the opportunity to contribute and drive innovative growth initiatives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and maintained several REST APIs across 5+ microservices in the client onboarding application, consisting of debit card creation and maintenance, resulting in a streamlined process for bankers.
•	Led the effort with a cross-functional team in delivering a service that provides bankers and clients the ability to easily view and set a card's transaction limits.
•	Developed a new microservice as part of the Card Personalization project and integrated multiple APIs used to submit and retrieve card shipping details from a third-party vendor.
•	Designed and implemented an SQL view joining vendor and internal data to support the automated processing of card and PIN special handling requests.
•	Developed and implemented a new application for data storage, serving as a robust persistence layer to enable decoupling of services from the database.
•	Configured Spring Boot's automatic application configuration to reduce boilerplate code and improve maintainability.
•	Regularly contributed to the technical documentation of the project, ensuring that critical information about the technology stack, application architecture, and development processes was accurately captured.
•	Implemented OAuth 2.0 authentication protocol for all endpoints, ensuring secure access to sensitive data and operations.
•	Enhanced logging framework to support the masking of sensitive client data across 40+ endpoints.
•	Ensured code quality and security by using Veracode and Aquasec to identify and remediate code and dependency vulnerabilities.
•	Optimized the performance and scalability of all applications by customizing the OpenShift YAML files with pod autoscaling components.
•	Utilized Git for version control and implemented CI/CD pipelines, ensuring efficient management of code changes throughout the development process.
•	Leveraged Jira Software to track project progress, collaborate with team members, identify and address blockers, and maintain clear communication.
